verdict.rationale: Solid's own docs state it is small and completely tree-shakable, and that state management is built in so no third-party library is needed, which keeps dependencies light. Community reports back this up: one rebuild came out 4x smaller, and others describe Solid as small and easy to inject into other pages. Missing for 10: concrete first-party bundle-size figures, an explicit zero/minimal runtime-dependency statement, any evidence addressing supply-chain risk directly.

support.subject: As a developer, I can ship a small, dependency-light client bundle to minimize runtime footprint and reduce supply-chain risk

citations.quote: Solid is small and completely tree-shakable
you don't have to reach for a third party library to manage global state
the commenter cites the result as 4x smaller and 50x faster
Uses Solid as a go-to for data viz because it is small and easy to inject into other pages.
